gotchas: Sign in first at /login (input[name="username"] takes the email, input[type="password"], Enter submits). Signed out, the cart's Checkout button does nothing: no prompt, no payment page.
Every new browser session gets a new-device check after sign-in: a verification code sent by email (input[aria-label*="verification code"]). It belongs to the account owner — hand it off.
The cart is a side panel (/store/cart is a 404). Add to Cart on a product page, then the visible Checkout button in the panel.

On the payment step, click "Pay with card" to reveal the card form. The only visible Stripe iframe is the express-checkout (wallet) button, not the card form: the card fields are plain inputs on the page, addressed by autocomplete (cc-name, postal-code, cc-exp, cc-number, cc-csc). Expiry accepted MM/YY.
Verified 2026-10-06 through the proxy (US tunnel) with the public test card under a verification-only key: all five fields filled, no aria-invalid or alert. Stopped before the order was placed.

2026-10-09 (staging proxy, local egress): after "Pay with card" the card inputs take a few seconds to mount; wait for cc-number to be visible before probing. Number, expiry (MM/YY) and security code filled with the test card under a verification-only key (card_fields_verified); the postal-code input was not actionable within 30 s on this run. Stopped before the order was placed.
The new-device code was supplied by the account owner from the signup inbox; the sign-in then landed on the signed-in store (account menu holds a Log out link).
